global_rules.mean_rule: Unless the prospective hypothesis explicitly says paired comparisons/count, arithmetic means are taken over the exact frozen summary rows named by the criterion, with every seed-condition row weighted equally.
global_rules.missing_required_evidence_rule: NOT_ADJUDICABLE_FROM_FROZEN_EVIDENCE; missingness must never be converted to NOT_SUPPORTED.
global_rules.pairing_rule: Where a hypothesis specifies paired seed-condition comparisons, pair only identical model_seed and identical frozen condition.
global_rules.precision_rule: Compute from persisted machine-readable numeric values using Python float64 arithmetic; do not round before threshold comparison. Displayed values may be rounded only after the decision.
global_rules.strictness_rule: Preserve the prospectively frozen comparison operators exactly: >=, >, or <.

V33_H1_TARGET_SIGNAL.descriptive_reporting: Existing persisted H1-related diagnostics may be reported descriptively but must not be used to manufacture a formal H1 decision.
V33_H1_TARGET_SIGNAL.reason: Step13B found no admissible persisted formal-training evidence sufficient for the two required distributional fractions, and no prospectively frozen aggregation rule converting epoch-level delta_u_std into the single H1 statistic.

V33_H2_SELECTOR_LEARNING.descriptive_reporting: The three computable subordinate criteria may be reported descriptively; no partial pass/fail pattern may be converted into a formal H2 decision.
prospective_supported_if: final validation utility_probability std across 19 frozen condition means >= 0.02
selector parameter L2 movement from initialization > 1e-6
median recorded selector gradient norm on non-neutral-target steps > 1e-8
active intervention rate > 0 in at least one degraded validation stratum
V33_H2_SELECTOR_LEARNING.reason: Step13B found no persisted selector-gradient evidence aligned at the required non-neutral-target-step granularity.

procedure.catastrophic_statistic: For M4qusli only, arithmetic mean of utility_probability.mean across the exact 4 frozen catastrophic conditions x 3 seeds (12 rows) minus arithmetic mean across clean x 3 seeds (3 rows).
procedure.decision: SUPPORTED iff both prospectively frozen criteria are satisfied; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED.
procedure.mismatch_statistic: For M4qusli only, arithmetic mean of utility_probability.mean across the three class_preserving_mismatched rows minus arithmetic mean across the three matched rows.

procedure.decision: SUPPORTED iff both deltas are >= -0.01; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED.
procedure.m1b_clean_mean: Arithmetic mean clean Macro-F1 for M1b across seeds 42,43,44.
procedure.m4qcsw_clean_mean: Arithmetic mean clean Macro-F1 for M4qcs-w across seeds 42,43,44.
procedure.primary_clean_mean: Arithmetic mean clean Macro-F1 for M4qusli across seeds 42,43,44.
procedure.successor_rule: If NOT_SUPPORTED, successor performance recommendation is prohibited exactly as prospectively frozen.

prospective_supported_if: mean clean Macro-F1 delta vs M1b >= -0.01
mean clean Macro-F1 delta vs M4qcs-w >= -0.01

procedure.catastrophic_delta: Arithmetic mean Macro-F1 across exact 4 catastrophic conditions x 3 seeds for M4qusli minus corresponding arithmetic mean for M4qcf.
procedure.decision_if_h4_not_supported: NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_PREREQUISITE. Subordinate H5 statistics may still be computed and reported descriptively, but cannot override the failed H4 prerequisite.
procedure.decision_if_h4_supported: SUPPORTED iff graded_mean_delta >= 0.005 AND positive_count >= 22 AND catastrophic_delta >= -0.01. Otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED.
procedure.graded_mean_delta: Arithmetic mean of the exact 36 paired deltas.
procedure.graded_pairs: Exactly 12 frozen graded conditions x seeds 42,43,44 = 36 pairs. For each pair: Macro-F1(M4qusli) - Macro-F1(M4qcs-w), matched on model_seed and condition.
procedure.positive_count: Count exact paired deltas strictly > 0. Zero is not positive.
procedure.prerequisite: Consume the formal H4 decision first.

prospective_supported_if: graded mean Macro-F1 delta vs M4qcs-w >= +0.005 across the frozen 36 paired seed-condition comparisons
catastrophic mean Macro-F1 delta vs M4qcf >= -0.01
